title: California Code of Regulations, Title 8, Section 3338. Pallets.
group: Group 2. Safe Practices and Personal Protection
content: (a) Pallets shall be constructed and maintained with strength adequate for the loads being handled. Unsafe and defective parts shall be repaired or replaced. Pallets upon which employees customarily walk in the course of the employment shall have no surface openings whose maximum dimension exceeds 2 inches.
